label: Landscape construction
note: €18,000 earthworks + €12,000 drainage + €34,000 hardscape. All three subcontract packages included.

label: Ground preparation & earthworks
note: Included in Terra Forma. Protection, site preparation, grading and ordinary spoil allowance. Unforeseen contamination excluded.

label: Drainage & irrigation distribution
note: Included in Terra Forma. Drainage routes and irrigation pipework; below-ground rainwater storage is optional and additional.

label: Paths, terraces & sunken lounge
note: Included in Terra Forma. €19,500 stone supply + €14,500 bedding, laying, gravel and lounge construction.

label: Limestone supply & fabrication
note: Second-tier subquote: included in Stone & Line, itself included in Terra Forma. Never add this again.

label: Charred-timber dining pavilion
note: €23,000 timber, roof and fitting + €9,000 structural metalwork. Outdoor kitchen is additional and optional.

label: Pavilion metalwork package
note: Included in Timber Field. Fabrication and fitting allowance; final engineering remains a review gate.

label: Optional outdoor kitchen
note: Additional to the €32,000 pavilion. Images show this option; unselected in the base budget.

label: Trees, meadow & woodland planting
note: Trees €11,000 + perennials/grasses €12,500 + woodland understorey €6,000. Concept quantities, pending survey and nursery approval.

label: Reflecting pool & water equipment
note: Decorative water feature allowance, not a swimming pool. Includes lining, edge coordination and recirculation equipment.

label: Garden lighting & controls
note: Fixtures €7,200 + cabling/installation €3,000 + controls/commissioning €2,200. Final electrical design by appointed specialist.

label: Outdoor furniture & objects
note: Base €14,500; premium teak, upholstery and larger dining selection €22,500. Covers loose furniture only.

label: Productive garden & oak beds
note: Four raised beds, gravel working surface, trellis and starter planting. Hand-filled surface water butt included.

label: Landscape design & coordination
note: Concept, design development, specifications and six site reviews. Surveys, permits and specialist engineering excluded.

label: First-year establishment care
note: Eight scheduled visits, planting establishment review and seasonal handover. Not a low-maintenance guarantee.

label: Client-held contingency
note: Planning reserve held by the client; not a supplier commitment.

label: Optional rainwater storage system
note: Additional to the drainage package: underground tank, pump and connection allowance. Site feasibility review required.

label: Unforeseen ground conditions
note: Unpriced and excluded: contaminated spoil, unexpected obstructions and exceptional ground remediation.
